findings.issue: Migration 014 marketplace_installs table is missing 'uninstalled_at TIMESTAMPTZ' column. Code at lib/marketplace.js:561 does 'SET uninstalled_at = NOW()' and queries with 'uninstalled_at IS NULL', but column doesn't exist in schema. All uninstall operations will fail at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Add 'uninstalled_at TIMESTAMPTZ' to marketplace_installs CREATE TABLE. Or create migration 017 with ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN.

findings.issue: INSERT into marketplace_installs (line 524) omits 'installed_by' column, but schema defines it as 'NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)'. Every install attempt will throw NOT NULL constraint violation. installed_by breaks audit trail.
findings.recommendation: Add installed_by to INSERT: 'INSERT INTO marketplace_installs (listing_id, team_id, version_id, installed_by, installed_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())'. Pass userId from route handler.

findings.issue: installListing() performs INSERT + UPDATE downloads counter as two separate queries without transaction. If UPDATE fails after INSERT succeeds, download count becomes inconsistent. Not catastrophic but breaks data integrity.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in BEGIN/COMMIT transaction, or use a trigger to auto-increment downloads on INSERT.

findings.issue: N+1 query pattern in exportMemoryObservations(). Loop calls checkDuplicateObservation() for each observation individually (lines 183-185). For 100 observations = 100 DB queries. Scales linearly and blocks Lambda execution.
findings.recommendation: Batch duplicate check: collect all content values, query with IN clause or ANY($1::text[]) in single query.

findings.issue: getTeamObservations() uses options.limit/options.offset without null-checking options object. If called with null options, parseInt(null, 10) returns NaN. Math.max(NaN, 1) returns NaN. Downstream SQL gets NaN as LIMIT.
findings.recommendation: Add 'const opts = options || {}' at function entry.

findings.issue: promoteEntry() returns { id, created, error } but executeKnowledgePromotion() returns { success, details }. Routes check result.created vs result.success inconsistently. Potential for missed error states.
findings.recommendation: Standardize all promotion functions to return { success, error, details } shape.

findings.issue: Pagination validation duplicated across 4+ route files (marketplace.js, marketplace-public.js, global-knowledge.js, model-intelligence.js) with minor variations in max limits (50, 100, 200).
findings.recommendation: Extract to shared utility: validatePagination(qs, { maxLimit, defaultLimit }).

findings.issue: Public marketplace browse endpoint (/api/marketplace/browse) has NO rate limiting. Unauthenticated — anyone can scrape all listings, enumerate data, or DoS the endpoint with unlimited requests.
findings.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware: 100 req/min per IP for browse, 30 req/min for reviews. Return 429 with Retry-After header.

findings.issue: handlePromote() accepts body.category without validating against VALID_GK_CATEGORIES whitelist. Only validates length (max 500). Allows arbitrary category injection, bypassing curation categories.
findings.recommendation: Validate: if (body.category && !VALID_GK_CATEGORIES.has(body.category)) return response(400, { error: 'Invalid category' }).

findings.issue: renderDetail() builds HTML via string concatenation and assigns to innerHTML. User-supplied tags, readme, and review body are escaped via escapeHtml() for text context, but attribute context escaping may be incomplete. HTML injection surface in marketplace detail page.
findings.recommendation: Use textContent for simple values. For complex HTML, use DOMPurify or createElement APIs. Avoid innerHTML with user-controlled data.

findings.issue: No duplicate install check at application layer. Relies solely on DB UNIQUE constraint (23505 error code). Should pre-check and give clear user message. Also, team_id check in uninstall only at DB level.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit pre-check before install. Ensure uninstall verifies team ownership at application layer too.

findings.issue: handlePromoteCommunityLearning() in model-intelligence routes duplicates the promotion call + validation already in global-knowledge.js handlePromote(). Both routes call promoteEntry() with identical flow.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared promotion handler. Both routes delegate to it.

findings.issue: checkDuplicateObservation() uses JSONB containment (@>) for matching but no GIN index on config_value. Query performance degrades with table growth.
findings.recommendation: Add GIN index on team_shared_configs(config_value) or use text comparison instead.
